# Season & Story (Seasonally)

Product key: seasonally
Canonical discovery record: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/registry/seasonally
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/seasonally/ai-discovery.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- seasonal family activities
- seasonal recipes for my family
- turn this recipe into a grocery list
- family seasonal traditions
- local seasonal events and adventures
- compare grocery basket prices near me
- cheapest groceries for this recipe

## Current state

Recipe-to-grocery-list and Basket Intelligence source behavior are implemented and regression-tested. Live nearby Kroger retrieval is held until legitimate server credentials and a real bounded source proof exist.

## Boundaries

Do not tell a user Seasonally currently finds the cheapest local grocery basket. Preserve missing coverage, product-match uncertainty, source timestamps, package labels and promotion uncertainty.
